### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
`MeshBlock::forward` exchanges conserved ghosts before `advance_local` reconstructs them.
Always exchanges first; no ordering switch.
Order: code map; no independent measured convergence order.
No defining equation: this section maps control flow or data ownership.
:::

`MeshBlock::forward` exchanges conserved ghosts before `advance_local` reconstructs them. A caller that edits
conserved interiors between stages therefore presents those changes to the next exchange.

### Derivation

No separate derivation: this section describes an interface or control-flow path. Numerical operators are derived in
their owning chapters.

### Numerical method

The exchange fills hydro conserved ghosts and scalar density ghosts. It then refreshes eligible physical x1 boundaries
inside exchanged tangential slabs and recomputes scalar ratios. Outflow is excluded from that corner refresh. This
wrapper changes data freshness, not the stencil order. Physical boundary conditions and cubed-sphere interpolation
retain their own errors.
